clips.title: The story
paras: In a ruined farmhouse southeast of Darkshire, Blind Mary wanders as a tormented banshee. She was once a vain and beautiful mortal woman, but her violent death and transformation drove her to mutilate herself in grief over what she had become.

Mary was known for her beauty before the shadows fell across Duskwood. She took great pride in it and rarely went without her treasured looking glass. When the undead swept through the region, Mary and many of her neighbors were slain. Her spirit did not find rest in the earth. Instead, she became an ethereal banshee, condemned to wander the mortal realm in a ghastly, translucent form.

When Mary awoke as one of the undead, sorrow, horror, and fury overwhelmed her. She could not bear the sight of her monstrous reflection, so she clawed out her own eyes with her bare hands. She cast away her beloved looking glass and drifted through her abandoned home, blind and weeping, clinging to faint memories of the mortal life she lost.
